overall.verdict: Comfort Home, Pay, Account and Sovereignty are close to a calm indigo fintech, but the one-scale bar is broken whenever two surfaces share a window, and Manage/Lending/Ownership/Desk abandon bars for vacant chrome or spreadsheets. Trust copy (frames, proofs, runtime) is ahead of visual hierarchy.
priority_fixes: Enforce one $N/px (Home Settings value) on every money bar including Home USDC vs Hub One, Move tiles, Assets rows, Sovereignty counterparties; overflow fade instead of rescaling.
Kill duplicate number legends under totals (Home, Sovereignty) and duplicate account bars on Pay (left preview vs right Before/After).
Rebuild Manage as an account list with bars; don't use a sitemap of tiles on a mostly empty desktop canvas.
Dead-end states: disable Swap/Offer/Sign until amount > 0; if lending API is missing, don't show a live form.
Desk must keep the notch-bar language in the position column or it is a second product; four KPI tiles repeating Home math should go.
